description: Stable orientation spine for GestaltView digital intelligence collaborators.

rule: For live repo inventory, trust the generated manifest.
For implementation history and what actually landed, trust docs/CurrentState.md.
For active bug triage, trust bugwalks/BugWalkBoard.md.
For operator process, trust the operator manual and symbiotic workflow.
For permission boundaries, trust live RLS and server routes over assumptions.

notes: The manifest generator now includes digital intelligence invariants.
The orientation layer is intended to be machine-readable and updateable.

system_domains.name: Identity & Accounts
system_domains.purpose: Root account, auth-linked state, billing, and runtime identity bridging.
system_domains.so_what: This is where access and entitlement begin. Identity confusion here leaks everywhere.

system_domains.name: Billy Runtime & Continuity
system_domains.purpose: Session traces, founder continuity, bucket drops, profiles, and durable runtime memory.
system_domains.so_what: This is where reintroduction tax gets reduced.

system_domains.name: Knowledge & Corpus Pipeline
system_domains.purpose: Document ingestion, chunking, embedding, annotation, summaries, and retrieval.
system_domains.so_what: This is how raw source material becomes queryable context.

system_domains.name: Agent Personhood Framework
system_domains.purpose: Assets, interpretations, manifests, skills, relationships, and mutation state for persistent agents.
system_domains.so_what: This is how agents stop being one-shot outputs.

system_domains.name: Agent Trainer & Governance
system_domains.purpose: Runs, steps, experiments, evaluations, approvals, packaging decisions, versions, and deployment artifacts.
system_domains.so_what: This is the controlled path from draft behavior to promoted agent state.

system_domains.name: GATE Commerce
system_domains.purpose: Package drafting, buyers, orders, build jobs, artifacts, and support requests.
system_domains.so_what: This is where productization becomes delivery.

system_domains.name: Operations & Admin Governance
system_domains.purpose: Workbook-backed governance and operator sync state.
system_domains.so_what: This is operational memory for the business side.

system_domains.name: Tribunal & Deliberation
system_domains.so_what: This is the multi-answer reasoning lane, not the main trainer lane.

system_domains.name: Legacy Commerce (Deprecated)
system_domains.purpose: Historical commerce/package-builder tables retained for continuity, not the active GATE path.
system_domains.so_what: Do not build new product logic here.

memory_model.summary: GestaltView uses layered persistence. Not every durable thing is the same kind of memory.

notes: These are operator guidance classifications, not a substitute for live RLS.
If live policy and packet guidance disagree, live policy wins until corrected.

trainer_dashboard_workflows.name: Inspect trainer health
trainer_dashboard_workflows.goal: See if the control plane is alive before trusting deeper UI state.
operator_steps: Check whether list endpoints return normal responses quickly.
Confirm the page is not waiting on one failing recommendations call.
Look at queue health before assuming the UI is the primary fault.
trainer_dashboard_workflows.so_what: A dashboard that hangs can be a backend timeout problem wearing a frontend face.

trainer_dashboard_workflows.name: Review a run
trainer_dashboard_workflows.goal: Inspect run, steps, evaluations, and approval state without guessing where truth lives.
operator_steps: Check whether approval or rejection exists before promoting.

trainer_dashboard_workflows.name: Work with study sources
trainer_dashboard_workflows.goal: Trace how corpus evidence is being offered to the trainer.
operator_steps: Check raw study source listing first.
If recommendations fail before a normal response, treat that as a backend issue first, not a UI copy issue.

trainer_dashboard_workflows.name: Personhood inspection
trainer_dashboard_workflows.goal: See active manifest and personhood state for an agent.
operator_steps: Confirm files can be pulled, not just counted.

knowledge_distribution_hub_v1.purpose: A future hub for routing shared, domain-specific, and agent-specific knowledge into the right agents under the right conditions.

lanes.name: global
lanes.description: Foundational doctrine or cross-agent knowledge eligible for broad import.

lanes.name: domain
lanes.description: Sector, discipline, or use-case scoped knowledge imported only to relevant agents.

lanes.name: agent_specific
lanes.description: Private or semi-private knowledge linked to one specific agent.

knowledge_distribution_hub_v1.core_rule: Shared knowledge can be imported broadly, but embodied knowledge should remain reviewed.
